pages.text: A $(thing)Compost Bin$() turns farm waste into compost. Put in $(thing)greens$() (manure, cut grass, spoiled grain, mouldy hay, scraps) and $(thing)browns$() (straw, dried hay, leaves, sticks).

About $(thing)two browns to one green$() rots fastest, in roughly three days. An all-green heap goes slimy and an all-brown one barely rots. $(thing)Turn$() it with a shovel, up to three times, to speed it up. Right-click with an empty hand to dig out the compost: half the volume that went in.
